messages:
Maya R.: heads up — CI flake on eval-runner: structured-output/toolcall tests failing only on q8b; schema validator: "Missing key 'arguments.user_id'"
Dave P.: repro? logs?
Maya R.: paste logs (trimmed):
```
2026-04-03T14:02:11Z eval-runner: received chunk 1: {"role":"tool","name":"create_user","function_call":{"name":"create_user","arguments":"{\"user_id\":123
2026-04-03T14:02:11Z eval-runner: received chunk 2: 45, \"email\": \"x@y.com\"}\"}}
2026-04-03T14:02:11Z parser: reassembled json -> malformed at boundary
2026-04-03T14:02:11Z schema-validator: path arguments.user_id not found
```
Sasha L.: looks like chunk boundary splitting the JSON string inside function_call.arguments — reassembly bug likely. we had ndjson framing issues before; runner's joiner assumes newline-delimited chunks.
Dave P.: weird it's only q8b. tokenization changes chunk boundaries so breaks fall inside quoted strings more often.
Lucas G.: confirmed locally: when function_call.arguments is a quoted JSON blob the stitcher drops escapes during join -> validator sees truncated string.
Maya R.: minimal reproducer I used:
```
# python pseudo
chunks = ['{"function_call":{"name":"create_user","arguments":"{\\"user_id\\":123', '45,\\"email\\":\\"x@y.com\\"}\"}}']
joined = ''.join(chunks)
# current joiner treats each chunk as a full ndjson line -> fails when no newline boundary
```
Dave P.: filing as flaky infra bug. Sasha, did the reassembly change you reverted last month touch this code?
Sasha L.: I reverted PR 9b4c3 for backpressure. later added a thin ndjson wrapper that assumes full-line chunks. that wrapper fails for quoted JSON blobs. I'll dig in.
EvalRunnerBot: re-run queued by @dave (job 91421-rerun)
ci-bot: rerun started :rocket:
Dave P.: short-term mitigation: add a tolerant reassembly step before schema validation that attempts to repair by balancing braces/quotes across the last 1-2 chunks.
Lucas G.: dashboard skew: eval dashboard shows ~96% pass but raw validator logs have many "partial-parse" warnings we currently count as success. product-facing metric = false confidence.
Maya R.: agree. that mismatch will hide regressions during onboarding.
Sasha L.: plan:
- add unit tests simulating chunk splits inside quoted strings and across escape sequences
- update stream-joiner to preserve escapes and not rely on newline framing
- add tolerant_reassembly fallback in validator (short-term)
- emit instrumentation tag parse_stage=(stream_join|tolerant_repair|strict_parse)
Dave P.: I'll add a CI gating rule: fail q8b job if tolerant_repair > 1 per 1000 evals.
Lucas G.: I'll change dashboard to use validator final_status rather than upstream success event; add tolerant_repair rate chart.
Maya R.: who picks up unit tests? low-hanging: construct two-chunk arrays and assert final json equals expected.
Dave P.: taking tests + gating rule. ETA EOD. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/1123
Sasha L.: owning stream-joiner patch, will submit tomorrow morning. pinging @security for review on tolerant repair to avoid accepting unterminated/untrusted JSON.
Maya R.: note: only surfaced with quantized models because chunk boundaries shift. reminder: test streaming edgecases across tokenizers during model bring-up.
Lucas G.: quick grep: `rg "tolerant_repair"` -> 18 hits across last week on q8b runs.
ci-bot: job 91421-rerun completed — no failures on rerun (flake). keeping ENG-4278 open until stream-joiner patch lands.
Maya R.: ENG-4278 -> https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ENG-4278
